notes: How this part was researched: one web search per candidate (30), after which the session's shared search allowance was spent; everything else was read by opening pages directly with the kit's honest User-Agent (states/net.py), each site's robots.txt obeyed, or with the page-reading tool. The campaign websites the candidates filed were learned from a scratch copy of the database on which the kit's own step (python -m ballot.local_sites files) had been run; each was then opened.

Not read, and nothing worked around: www.jeremymunson.com and www.jessicaformnhouse.com (the sites Jeremy Munson and Jessica L. Johnson filed; each one's robots.txt asks scripts to stay out, so no website finding and no own words are recorded for them and the filed address stands on its own); judgedanielmoreno.com (the site Daniel C. Moreno filed: 404 without www, 429 with www on two tries, so not recorded); mncourts.gov (robots.txt: no court page for Judge Moreno or Judge Saterbak); mnbar.org (connection refused) and mcaa-mn.org (robots.txt), which carry the Governor's 2019 release on Melissa Saterbak's appointment, so nothing is recorded for her; www.ci.bemidji.mn.us (robots.txt: no city page for Audrey M. Thayer); www.perham.k12.mn.us (no answer on three tries: no district page for Justine Anderson); the Steele County Times's search (robots.txt).

No party endorsement is recorded for anyone. The Marshall Independent (May 6, 2026) reports that Brad Hennen received the Republican endorsement at the House District 15A convention in Cottonwood, and the Mankato Free Press is reported to describe a Senate District 22 Republican convention favouring Jeremy Munson; neither is a party's own page, and no Republican unit's own endorsement page for Munson, Lieske, Hennen, Johnson or Lopac was found (the state DFL's list, the Lyon County, Carver County and Isanti County Republican pages were read and name none of this part's candidates; no searches were left to find the other units).

Left blank on purpose. Rick Gnemi (Owatonna council, Ward 3): the Steele County Times (November 6, 2024) reports that a Rick Gnemi held Steele County's District 3 commissioner seat from 2016 until he lost in 2024, but no page was found tying that commissioner to this year's council candidacy, so the office is not recorded; a second reader with a search could settle it. Audrey M. Thayer: KAXE gives her age on Election Day (75), which does not fix a birth year, so none is recorded. The Minnesota Legislative Reference Library's page gives Jeremy Munson's date of birth as 12/31/1976; only the year is recorded, since a year-end day may be a placeholder. Corey R. Sik: Lincoln County's sheriff page names Bob Bushman as sheriff; nothing was found about Sik. Nothing was found for James Checkel (Dodge County's District 3 page is about the sitting commissioner, Rodney Peterson), Travis Bowman (the Le Sueur County News says he did not take part in its candidate profiles), Angie Skavnak beyond her own site (the district's election page lists her affidavit), Darren Romans, Douglas Witherington (the Shakopee district's election page calls him a new candidate), Lisa Moore, Tom Lopac beyond his own site, or Melissa Saterbak.
Things seen and not recorded, by rule: family, religion, schools, employers and jobs on the Legislative Reference Library's, the counties', the cities' and the campaigns' pages.
